items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: Well, we used to say it was Take Old Man Bailey's Advice. There was a guy who owned this time called Bailey

ctx.x: TOBA? What do those initials stand for?
Well, we used to say it was Take Old Man

Bailey's Advice. There was a guy who owned this time called Bailey, but I think it was -- I don't know what the legitimate names -- but TOBA -- that was the black vaudeville circuit, and many, many vaudeville teams originated -- some of them became headliners in the white circuit, some of them never went any farther than TOBA. [Theater Owners Booking Association]
